name: Staged: king on the bathroom wall with floating nightstands, a reading chair where the dresser was
notes:
Staged pick, 2026-10-24 (F-64): a king and no dresser. Andrew: "there is a GIANT walk in closet ... so we do NOT need a dresser for sure", "Try to fit a kingsize bed in master, still need nightstands", and of the dresser layouts "Keep the dresser version in tact though as alternaitves, it's still nice": they are b to g, g being the MALM queen staged before. 14 placed, 10 extras; every piece a suggestion in a staged layout (F-50).
A king fits one way only: headboard end on the right (bathroom) wall, between the heater's 12" for bedding (y 18) and the bathroom door's 36" landing (y 97), so the frame can be at most 79" across. The Mellow pine platform is the narrowest king in the catalog, 75.5" (its mattress overhangs it 1/4" a side); the Yaheetech dark-walnut king (amazon-B0DWMSPBMZ, 78.5") is the darker option, closer to the MALM, and leaves 12.5" from the heater face; the MALM King (82 1/4") and the TARVA King (79 1/8") don't fit the slot. The floor beside the head belongs to the heater on the window side and to the bathroom landing on the other, so both nightstands are LACK wall shelves.
bed-1 Mellow king platform, natural pine (floor): right wall, rot 90, x 97.5-177, y 21.5-97. F-34: window side 21.5" from the wall, 15.5" from the heater's drawn face along the last 30" at the head (tight:15.5); bathroom side 36", to the bottom wall across the bathroom door's landing (F-31, assumed-position:door). F-33: the mattress edge 15.25" from the heater face (12" min); heater-depth-assumed. No headboard: the pillows rest against the wall under the art.
shelf-1 LACK wall shelf (top): the bathroom side's nightstand, x 166.75-177, y 97-108.75, at mattress height, so the bathroom landing stays clear (F-31). shelf-2 LACK wall shelf (top): the window side's nightstand, x 166.75-177, y 9.75-21.5, at mattress height above the heater's end, 3.75" from its drawn face (against-heater, heater-depth-assumed). 6.5 lb max each and anchored (IKEA): a lamp, a phone, a book.
lamp-1, lamp-2 STORSEGEL (top): one on each shelf, the 7" base on the 11 3/4 x 10 1/4" shelf. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the bed, centered, x 176-177, y 31.75-86.75: about 73% of the bed's width.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 7'10"x9'10" jute (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 18-112: under the lower 60.5" of the bed, 3.5" past its window side, 15" past its bathroom side and 57.5" past its foot, out to the reading chair; 12" off the heater face (F-33), 4.5" short of the BESTÅ column.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine bench (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 86.5-97.5, y 39.6-78.9, centered on the bed: pine with the pine frame, a seat and blanket storage.
chair-1 POÄNG (floor): the reading corner where the dresser stood, left wall, rot 270, x 0-32.25, y 21-47.75, facing the bed. F-33: upholstery 15" from a full-wall heater face (12" min). floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): beside it in the window-side corner, x 0-9, y 12-21; F-33: 6" from the heater face; heater-depth-assumed. plant-1 FEJKA areca palm (floor): beside the chair, x 0-4.75, y 49-53.75.
hamper-1 PURRPINGLA (floor): left wall by the door, x 0-17.3, y 92-100. F-31: 3" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels. F-31: 3" to the side of the closet's 36" landing (assumed-position:closet); anchor-required (F-21: 76").
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4.
Walkways (F-30): from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 37.6" between the bench and the BESTÅ column, then 36" beside the bed; 54" between the reading chair and the bench up to the window side; the closet's and the bathroom door's 36" landings stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Extras: the king's VALEVÅG mattress x1 (ships rolled, F-22), DVALA King sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE King insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA King cover set, natural x1, VILDKORN Queen pillows x2 (the DVALA King's cases are 20x36, king pillows; none in the catalog), FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window).
Not placed: a dresser (the walk-in closet holds the clothes; the STORKLINTA is in b to g); the VIHALS floor nightstand (its corner is the heater's 6"); the MALM King ikea-09574348 and the TARVA King ikea-09418584 (82 1/4" and 79 1/8": too wide for the slot); the Yaheetech king amazon-B0DWMSPBMZ (the darker option, 12.5" from the heater face).
Total $1,886.78: placed $1,097.88 + extras $788.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02), 2026-10-23 (the BESTÅ column) and 2026-10-24 (the king frame, mattress and bedding). The old staged MALM queen with the dresser, now g, was $1,938.79.
Flags across the layout: tight:15.5 (bed-1, F-34), against-heater (shelf-2), heater-depth-assumed, assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (storage-1).
